packages.title: YouTube AdFree

manifest.title: YouTube AdFree
manifest.appDescription: GTV development build of YouTube AdFree, built from webosbrew upstream 0.5.3. It keeps the release ad-blocking, Shorts-removal, sponsored-overlay, and playback-hook hardening. DEV diagnostics now pin every exact isAdPlayback boolean with its value, response shape, nearest player response, and immediate before/after response summaries; they also name framework payload entity types such as qrCodeEntity and retain only safe schema hints. The broad structural inventories remain available, with camel-case token matching to avoid false ad signals from unrelated keys such as payload, readahead, and adaptiveFormats. Blue opens the frozen paged report and advances one page per press; Back is the only way to close it.

packages.shortDescription: Development build with targeted ad-playback and entity diagnostics plus hardened ad blocking.
